survivors.claim: Commit 2d92826 (HEAD of the range) rewrites cmdRecord outside every File Plan row and drops the `--briefs` forwarding to verdict.js: the flag is still parsed and stuffed into `recordContext.briefs`, but the `verdictArgs.push('--briefs', briefs)` line was deleted, so the release ledger row loses its `briefs` array.
survivors.impact: Every release recorded from this build silently loses the list of shipped briefs from its ledger row, so the release stage's own documented invocation (release.md line 175 passes the shipped brief numbers) no longer lands what it promises, and the change is not anything the spec asked for.
survivors.evidence: Spec File Plan for release-legs.js names no Decision touching `record`. Hunk (git show 2d92826): -  if (briefs) verdictArgs.push('--briefs', briefs) / +  const recordContext = { root, manifest, milestone, briefs }. Executed repro through the real script against a synthetic host (7 green rows; base extracted with `git archive bace2b7`): HEAD: record --milestone v1.2.3 --briefs 12,13 -> exit 0, ledger row briefs=undefined hasBriefsKey=false; base bace2b7: same invocation -> ledger row briefs=[12,13] hasBriefsKey=true. No test in tests/release-legs/ exercises `record --briefs`, which is why the suite stayed green on it.
